correctness.rationale: The seven explicit cubics span the entire real degree-three harmonic eigenspace; exact spherical even-monomial moments give E[Y^2]=2 tr(M)/35 and E[Y^4]=4(7 tr(M)^2+6 tr(M^2))/5005. Exact rational coefficientwise expansion verifies all 210 degree-four parameter monomials in the published basis, and the checker verifies harmonicity, independence and tracefreeness. Subtraction gives precisely 24/5005 times ||M-tr(M)I/3||_F^2, nonnegative for every tensor. The explicit xyz harmonic is isotropic and attains the constant 315/143; no general claim relies on numerical sampling.

value.rationale: A natural classical question seeks least L4 concentration at fixed spherical harmonic degree; the exact minimum for the full seven-dimensional real cubic eigenspace is strictly larger than the universal Holder lower bound. The nonnegative equality-deficit formula is quantitative and coordinate-free, allowing all real cubic harmonic equality cases to be tested via a 3x3 isotropy matrix. It is not a selected low-dimensional numerical slice, a known-table restatement, or a routine substitution of the second-degree theorem.
